t: This is the site of the Fann Street Foundry, an English type foundry on Fann Street in the City of London. It no longer operates. It was founded by Robert Thorne, a typographer and type founder who lived from 1754 to 1820. He had been an apprentice to Thomas Cottrell, who in turn had worked for William Caslon, and he later acquired Cottrell's foundry. He did well in business and left a fortune of twenty-five thousand pounds.
